title: Video: Digital Foundry Delivers Its Tech Review For Resident Evil 4 On Switch 2
summary:
Plus impressions for RE2 and 3.

Digital Foundry has provided its tech review for Resident Evil 4 on Switch 2, while also sharing some brief impressions of RE2 and RE3.

Starting with RE4, it's noted that the game has a "range of downgrades" compared to its PS5 counterpart, which isn't particularly surprising. Some local light sources don't cast real-time shadows in some situations, though the shadows that are there are at least at a similar resolution.

title: Nintendo's London Comic-Con Booth Features Playable Layton, Metaphor, 007 & More
summary:
19 games to try.

Nintendo is returning to MCM London Comic-Con later this month from 23rd - 25th October, and it has got quite the roster of playable demos lined up.

As shared on the company's socials today, the Nintendo booth will let attendees go hands-on with upcoming titles like Professor Layton and The New World of Steam, Metaphor: ReFantazio, 007 First Light, Rayman Legends Retold and Monster Hunter Wilds. There's also the chance to check out some of the Switch 2's best releases to date, with Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokémon Pokopia and Splatoon Raiders all making an appearance.

title: This Gorgeous 'Stop-Motion' Adventure Swims Onto Switch 2 Next Month
summary:
The name's Halibut, Harold Halibut.

Harold Halibut released back in 2024 with one of those visual styles that immediately made us sit up and pay attention. In the two years since, we have been hoping that its stop-motion-esque stylings might one day make the jump to Switch and next month, it's set to do exactly that.

Developer Slow Bros announced yesterday that Harold Halibut will arrive on Switch 2 on 12th November, and while there's every chance that we might be a little preoccupied with certain other games around then, we think it'll be well worth a look.

title: Video: The Walking Dead's Chandler Riggs Stars In Resident Evil 7 Short Film
summary:
Welcome to the family, Coral.

Chandler Riggs, perhaps best known for his role as Coral Carl Grimes in the TV adaptation of The Walking Dead, has released a short film based on Resident Evil 7: Biohazard in collaboration with Spook Fest Films. Riggs not only stars in it, but he also wrote, directed, and edited the whole thing.

The film has not been created for profit, but rather to showcase Tampa Bay as "a strong, supportive, and experienced home for film productions". Even better, no AI was used in the production, and the description states that it may not be used to train AI. Cool.

title: Kotaro Uchikoshi, Creator Of Zero Escape And AI: The Somnium Files, Launches New Studio
summary:
It's currently seeking investment for original projects.

Kotaro Uchikoshi, the creator behind IP such as Zero Escape and AI: The Somnium Files, has launched a new development studio called Crash Keys and is serving as its representative director and CEO.

It's early days yet (sort of – keep reading), but the studio is looking to create original projects "unbound by conventional formulas" and is currently seeking investment partners to help bring its vision to life. Uchikoshi-san also co-founded Too Kyo Games alongside Kazutaka Kodaka, co-directing titles such as World's End Club and The Hundred Line - Last Defense Academy.

title: RedLynx, The Studio Behind The Trials Series, Is Being Closed By Ubisoft
summary:
Another one bites the dust.

If you were around during the height of the 'Xbox Live Arcade' initiative, then you might have played a little game called Trials HD. It was a big part of the second 'Summer of Arcade' event when it launched in 2009, garnering positive reception and helping Finnish developer RedLynx produce several sequels, including Trials Evolution, Trials Fusion, and Trials Rising. Nintendo fans only received the latter entry on Switch, but the entire series is well worth playing, if you can.

title: Oblivion Remastered Gets A New Switch 2 Update, Resolves "Global Visual Degradation" Issue
summary:
